description: Sensores de riego is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de Santander. This dataset provides information on measurements taken by sensors distributed in the city of Santander on data related to soil moisture, relative humidity, wind speed... The data is provided by Orion Context Broker, from the Fiware platform In this dataset you can find among others the following information: atmosphericPressure: Atmospheric pressure measured in Bars). Coverage: Ayuntamiento de Santander. The portal shows the English title as "Irrigation sensors" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ayuntamiento de Santander. Its keywords include Fiware, sensores, viento, humedad, agua. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, N3, TURTLE, LD%2BJSON. The listing shows 2016-08-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.es). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
